name: print-social-remote-tech-program-post-with-numbered-green-rows-and-pr-tiles
title: 'Remote Tech Program' post with numbered green-ringed rows and floating 'PR' app tiles
whatItIs: A square black-green post with a neon green 'Remote Tech Program' title, a white question subhead, and a glass panel listing four numbered rows (01 Profile Picture, 02 Headline, 03 About Section, 04 Work Experience) with green-ringed numbers, plus three tilted glossy green 'PR' app-icon tiles floating around.
whatItMeans: Motivating and structured; the checklist makes profile advice actionable and techy.
techniques: Number tips in outlined neon rings.
Float tilted app-icon tiles around a panel.
Bold the label and keep the tip short.
Glow a green gradient from the top.

vocabulary.definition: A list item led by a number badge.
A rounded square like a phone icon.
